title: Email DNS Posture
description: Email DNS security posture for a list of domains

collected_at.description: When the collector read the domains' DNS records, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

domains.x-epack-summary: Email authentication posture for each domain.

summary.x-epack-summary: Email authentication coverage across all domains.

diagnostics.x-epack-summary: Errors and warnings raised during collection.

mx.x-epack-summary: Mail servers that receive mail for the domain.

spf.x-epack-summary: The domain's SPF record. It lists the servers allowed to send mail for the domain.

dmarc.x-epack-summary: The DMARC record and the policy it sets for mail that fails authentication.

dkim.x-epack-summary: DKIM signing keys published for the domain.

assessment.x-epack-summary: Email authentication assessment for the domain.

errors.description: Problems the collector hit while reading this domain's DNS records, such as a lookup that timed out.

priority.x-epack-summary: Priority of this mail server. A lower value means a higher priority.

valid.x-epack-summary: Whether the domain's SPF record is valid.

policy.description: The policy the record requests for the domain, from its p tag. For a record without a valid p tag, this is none when the record lists a valid rua URI, as RFC 9989 specifies. It is unknown when no DMARC processing applies to the record

subdomain_policy.description: The policy the record requests for existing subdomains, from its sp tag. When the record has no sp tag, this is the same as policy

pct.description: The pct tag defined in RFC 7489. RFC 9989 drops it, and receivers ignore it. It is recorded for reference and does not affect any other value
pct.x-epack-summary: Percentage set by the record's pct tag. RFC 9989 removed this tag, and receivers ignore it.

rua.description: The aggregate report URIs from the rua tag, as written

ruf.description: The failure report URIs from the ruf tag, as written

valid.x-epack-summary: Whether the DMARC record is valid.
Whether this DKIM record is valid.

enforced.description: True if the DMARC policy that applies to the domain rejects failing mail. That is p=reject on the domain's own record, or a subdomain policy of reject on the record that RFC 9989's DNS tree walk finds above the domain. The subdomain policy is sp, or p when the record has no sp. In either case the record must not set t=y. With t=y, receivers apply the policy one level lower
enforced.x-epack-summary: Whether the DMARC policy that applies to the domain rejects failing mail. A policy marked for testing with t=y is not enforced.

has_reporting.description: True if the DMARC record that applies to the domain lists at least one valid rua URI, such as mailto:dmarc@example.com. An address without a scheme is not a URI, and receivers do not send reports to it
has_reporting.x-epack-summary: Whether the DMARC record that applies to the domain lists a valid aggregate report address.

with_mx_count.description: Number of domains with at least one MX record
with_mx_count.x-epack-summary: Domains with at least one MX record.

with_mx_pct.description: Percentage of domains with MX records
with_mx_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of domains with at least one MX record.

with_spf_count.description: Number of domains with an SPF record, valid or not
with_spf_count.x-epack-summary: Domains with an SPF record, whether or not it is valid.

with_spf_pct.description: Percentage of domains with SPF records
with_spf_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of domains with an SPF record, whether or not it is valid.

with_dmarc_count.description: Number of domains that a DMARC record applies to, valid or not. The record is the domain's own, or the one RFC 9989's DNS tree walk finds above it
with_dmarc_count.x-epack-summary: Domains that a DMARC record applies to, whether or not it is valid. The record can be the domain's own or a parent domain's.

with_dmarc_pct.description: Percentage of domains that a DMARC record applies to, counted as in with_dmarc_count
with_dmarc_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of domains that a DMARC record applies to, whether or not it is valid. The record can be the domain's own or a parent domain's.

with_dkim_count.description: Number of domains with a DKIM record at one of the common selectors
with_dkim_count.x-epack-summary: Domains with a DKIM record at a common selector.

with_dkim_pct.description: Percentage of domains with DKIM records
with_dkim_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of domains with a DKIM record at a common selector.

with_all_three_count.description: Number of domains with MX and SPF records and a DMARC record that applies to them
with_all_three_count.x-epack-label: Domains with MX, SPF, and DMARC
with_all_three_count.x-epack-summary: Domains with MX and SPF records and a DMARC record that applies to them.

with_all_three_pct.description: Percentage of domains with MX and SPF records and a DMARC record that applies to them
with_all_three_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of domains with MX and SPF records and a DMARC record that applies to them.

enforced_count.description: Number of domains whose applicable DMARC policy rejects failing mail (assessment.enforced is true)
enforced_count.x-epack-summary: Domains whose DMARC policy rejects failing mail.

enforced_pct.description: Percentage of domains whose applicable DMARC policy rejects failing mail (assessment.enforced is true)
enforced_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of domains whose DMARC policy rejects failing mail.

with_reporting_count.description: Number of domains whose applicable DMARC record lists a valid rua URI (assessment.has_reporting is true)
with_reporting_count.x-epack-summary: Domains whose DMARC record lists a valid aggregate report address.

with_reporting_pct.description: Percentage of domains whose applicable DMARC record lists a valid rua URI (assessment.has_reporting is true)
with_reporting_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of domains whose DMARC record lists a valid aggregate report address.

all_enforced.description: True if every domain's applicable DMARC policy rejects failing mail (assessment.enforced is true for every domain)
all_enforced.x-epack-summary: Whether every domain's DMARC policy rejects failing mail.
